items.exampleEn: I can hear a strange noise.

items.exampleEn: I wash the dishes after dinner.
Water comes out of this tube.

items.exampleZh: 他們住在城裡的一間小公寓。

items.exampleEn: The clock on the wall is slow.
The books are on the shelf.
I brush my teeth every morning.

items.sentenceEn: Please put the clock on the shelf.

items.audioEn: I can hear the bell. Can you open the door?
items.audioZh: 我聽到門鈴聲了，你可以去開門嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The water in this tube is very cold.

items.stemEn: Please ____ the cups. They are dirty.
items.stemZh: 請把杯子洗一洗，它們很髒。

items.stemEn: What is that ____? Is someone at the door?
items.stemZh: 那是什麼聲音？有人在門口嗎？

items.passageEn: Ben lives in a small flat. Every morning, the clock on his shelf rings at six. He gets up, washes his face, and brushes his teeth. One morning, he hears a noise at the door. It is the bell! His friend is there with breakfast.
items.passageZh: Ben 住在一間小公寓裡。每天早上，他架子上的時鐘六點會響。他起床、洗臉、刷牙。有一天早上，他聽到門口有聲音，是門鈴！他的朋友帶著早餐來了。

items.promptZh: 我每天早上和晚上都刷牙。
referenceEn: I brush my teeth every morning and night.
I brush my teeth in the morning and at night.
rubricZh: 「刷牙」用 brush my teeth（teeth 是複數）
習慣性的事用現在簡單式
時間可寫 every morning and night、in the morning and at night、twice a day 等

referenceEn: My father washes the car on Sundays.
My dad washes the car on Sunday.
rubricZh: wash 後面直接接要洗的東西（例如 washes the car）；動詞配合主詞
「星期天」可寫，例如 on Sundays、on Sunday 等
